subject: 日本海・せたな町
evidence: A high aerial drone view over the coast of Setana on the Sea of Japan in southwestern Hokkaido, in mid-April early spring: a calm grey-blue sea, rocky headlands and a sea stack, a small quiet town of low houses along the shore, forested hills behind with bare and budding trees, no snow anywhere except a few thin patches on the distant ridges, no winter.
reason: ナレーションの主題である日本海とせたな町の海岸が描かれている。
